results.question: How many customers are there
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerId) AS total_customers FROM customers c

results.question: what are the top 5 countries that customers come from?
results.sql:
SELECT 
    c.Country AS Country,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.CustomerId) AS CustomerCount
FROM 
    invoices i
JOIN 
    customers c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
GROUP BY 
    c.Country
ORDER BY 
    CustomerCount DESC
LIMIT 5

results.question: List all albums and their corresponding artist names
results.sql: SELECT T1.Title, T2.Name FROM albums AS T1 JOIN artists AS T2 ON T1.ArtistId = T2.ArtistId

results.question: Find all tracks with a name containing "What" (case-insensitive)
results.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT t.name 
FROM tracks AS t 
JOIN playlist_track ON t.TrackId = playlist_track.TrackId
WHERE LOWER(t.name) LIKE '%what%'

results.question: Get the total number of invoices for each customer
results.sql:
SELECT 
    c.CustomerId,
    COUNT(i.InvoiceId) AS TotalNumberofInvoices
FROM 
    customers c
JOIN 
    employees e ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId
JOIN 
    invoices i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
GROUP BY 
    c.CustomerId

results.question: Find the total number of invoices per country:
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.BillingCountry) AS TotalInvoicesPerCountry FROM invoices AS T1 JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.CustomerId

results.question: List all invoices with a total exceeding $10:
results.sql:
SELECT 
    i.InvoiceId,
    i.Total
FROM 
    invoices i
WHERE 
    i.Total > 10000

results.question: Find all invoices since 2010 and the total amount invoiced:
results.sql:
SELECT 
    i.InvoiceId,
    i.Total AS invoice_total
FROM 
    invoices i
JOIN 
    invoice_items ii ON i.InvoiceId = ii.InvoiceId
WHERE 
    i.InvoiceDate >= '2010-01-01'
GROUP BY 
    i.InvoiceId

results.question: List all employees and their reporting manager's name (if any)
results.sql:
SELECT e.LastName, COALESCE(e2.LastName, 'No manager') AS ManagerName 
FROM employees e 
LEFT JOIN employees e2 ON e.ReportsTo = e2.EmployeeId

results.question: Get the average invoice total for each customer
results.sql:
SELECT 
    customers.FirstName AS 'Customer First Name',
    customers.LastName AS 'Customer Last Name',
    AVG(invoices.Total) AS 'Average Invoice Total'
FROM 
    invoices
INNER JOIN 
    customers ON customers.CustomerId = invoices.CustomerId
GROUP BY 
    customers.CustomerId

results.question: Find the top 5 most expensive tracks (based on unit price)
results.sql:
SELECT t.Name AS track_name, SUM(ii.UnitPrice) OVER (PARTITION BY ii.TrackId ORDER BY ii.UnitPrice DESC) AS total_expense 
FROM invoice_items ii
JOIN tracks t ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId
GROUP BY t.Name
ORDER BY total_expense DESC
LIMIT 5

results.question: List all genres and the number of tracks in each genre:
results.sql:
SELECT 
    g.Name AS GenreName,
    COUNT(t.TrackId) AS NumTracksInGenre
FROM 
    genres g
JOIN 
    tracks t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
GROUP BY 
    g.Name

results.question: Get all genres that do not have any tracks associated with them:
results.sql: SELECT g.Name FROM genres AS g LEFT JOIN tracks AS t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId WHERE t.TrackId IS NULL LIMIT 5

results.question: List all customers who have not placed any orders:
results.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.* 
FROM (customers c 
     LEFT JOIN invoices i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId) 
WHERE i.InvoiceId IS NULL

results.question: There are 3 tables: artists, albums and tracks, where albums and artists are linked by ArtistId, albums and tracks are linked by AlbumId, Can you find the top 10 most popular artists based on the number of tracks
results.sql: SELECT artists.Name, COUNT(DISTINCT tracks.TrackId) AS num_tracks FROM tracks JOIN albums ON tracks.AlbumId = albums.AlbumId JOIN artists ON albums.ArtistId = artists.ArtistId GROUP BY artists.ArtistId ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT tracks.TrackId) DESC LIMIT 10

results.question: List all customers from Canada and their email addresses:
results.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.FirstName, T1.Email FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN employees AS T2 ON T1.SupportRepId = T2.EmployeeId WHERE T2.Country = 'Canada'

results.question: Find the customer with the most invoices
results.sql:
SELECT customers.CustomerId, customers.FirstName, customers.LastName 
FROM customers 
JOIN invoices ON customers.CustomerId = invoices.CustomerId 
GROUP BY customers.CustomerId 
ORDER BY COUNT(invoices.InvoiceId) DESC 
LIMIT 1

results.question: Find the customer who bought the most albums in total quantity (across all invoices)
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t2.CustomerId) AS CustomerWithMostAlbumsBought
FROM tracks t1
JOIN invoice_items ti ON t1.TrackId = ti.TrackId
JOIN invoices i ON ti.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
JOIN customers t2 ON i.CustomerId = t2.CustomerId

results.question: Hint: album quantity is found in invoice_items, Find the top 5 customers who bought the most albums in total quantity (across all invoices):
results.sql:
SELECT 
    c.FirstName,
    c.LastName,
    SUM(ii.Quantity) AS AlbumQuantity
FROM 
    customers c 
JOIN 
    invoices i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
JOIN 
    invoice_items ii ON i.InvoiceId = ii.InvoiceId
JOIN 
    tracks t ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN 
    albums a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId
GROUP BY 
    c.FirstName, c.LastName
ORDER BY 
    AlbumQuantity DESC
LIMIT 5

results.question: Find the top 5 customers who spent the most money overall, Hint: order total can be found on invoices table, calculation using invoice_items detail table is unnecessary
results.sql:
SELECT T2.FirstName, T2.LastName,
       SUM(T1.Total) AS total_spent
FROM invoices AS T1
JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerId = T2.CustomerId
GROUP BY T2.FirstName, T2.LastName
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 5

results.question: Get all playlists containing at least 10 tracks and the total duration of those tracks:
results.sql:
SELECT 
    p.Name AS PlaylistName,
    SUM(t.Milliseconds) / 60000.0 AS TotalDuration
FROM 
    playlist_track t1
JOIN 
    tracks t ON t1.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN 
    playlists p ON t1.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId
GROUP BY 
    p.Name
HAVING 
    COUNT(t1.TrackId) >= 10

results.question: Identify artists who have albums with tracks appearing in multiple genres:
results.sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.Name FROM albums AS T1 INNER JOIN tracks AS T2 ON T1.AlbumId = T2.AlbumId INNER JOIN genres AS T3 ON T2.GenreId = T3.GenreId WHERE T2.GenreId IN ( SELECT GenreId FROM tracks GROUP BY GenreId HAVING COUNT(Distinct TrackId) > 1 )
